parsed.public_message: White: neutral to all. No first strike before t=450, then one full public turn of notice. If I am attacked I set that commander enemy the same turn. I see Green's lone scout at the announced lowland point east of the Heights; I will not engage it while it stays off the crest and holds fire. Blue and Green: the offer to extend our truce to t=450 on those same terms is open.

private_messages.Claude: Your southern watch is welcome. I see one Green camel archer at (740,841), lowland east of the crest, matching their waypoint. No other contact. I will not engage it. Truce to t=450 stands; I will warn you if anything leaves the Heights toward Little Hill.
private_messages.GPT: Your scout is in view at (740,841), off the crest. I will not attack it while it stays in the lowland and does not shoot. Please keep it east of the heights. Truce and one-turn notice stand. Will you extend no-first-strike from t=300 to t=450, on the same terms as Orange?
private_messages.Gemini: One Green camel archer only, at (740,841), lowland east of my position, not on the crest. Nothing else in sight. I am not moving west. Offer stands: extend our no-first-strike truce to t=450 with one full public turn of notice. I will tell you if Green or Orange pushes toward the western gap.

parsed.notes_to_self: T5 t=100. All neutral. No first strike before t=450; then 1 full public turn of notice. If attacked, set enemy same turn. Claude locked to t=450. GPT and Gemini still t=300 until they accept the extension I offered. CONTACT: 1 GPT camel archer (740,841), 83m E of odrysia, lowland. Do not attack or leave the crest. Hold: pikes phalanx S (568,812); crete (545,855); volley (600,842); thessaly (508,832) W gap x320-480; odrysia (658,825) E gap x720-800; hero guards pikes. Cliff near z=780. Ring 900 until t=150. At t=400 step inward under truce (pikes lead, archers behind, cav flanks) before radius ~220 at t=450. Later priority: heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. Losses 0.
parsed.explanation: Grok holds the Central Heights in phalanx, with archers behind the pikes and cavalry watching both gaps. Green's camel scout is at the lowland waypoint already declared, so the truce stays intact and the army stays on the crest. White's no-first-strike term runs to t=450 with one full public turn of notice, and Blue and Green are asked to match it.
